initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a cozy isometric farming town game. Six separate fully isolated buildings arranged in strict 3 columns x 2 rows on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Warm detailed hand-painted miniature architecture, terracotta roofs, pale plaster, warm wood, green foliage, upper-left sunlight. Same 2:1 isometric perspective, each building faces southwest/southeast with visible front and right sides. Each object fully contained in its equal sized cell with at least 8 percent transparent padding. No words, numbers, grid, scenery background, checkerboard, watermark or cast shadow outside object. Top row left flower nursery with flower beds and small potting shed; top row middle orchard keeper cottage with crates, pruning tools and two small fruit trees; top row right charming chicken coop with fenced small yard, a hen and chicks. Bottom row left jam kitchen workshop with copper jam pot, red berry jars on a table; bottom row middle riverside tea house with open wooden veranda, two low tables and flowering shrubs, no surrounding water; bottom row right spacious farmhouse residence with planted courtyard, flower windows and washing line. Rustic peaceful European-inspired valley village. Buildings are roughly same game-scale footprint; farmhouse and tea house slightly wider. Clear readable silhouettes for display at 140 pixels wide. Transparent background is required.
rejectedAlphaEdit: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied six-building atlas. Remove the entire brown/green gradient backdrop and all background glow, replacing it with genuine alpha transparency. Keep all six buildings, their flowers, fences, courtyards, chickens, and props unchanged. Maintain 3 columns x 2 rows and same relative placement. No backdrop, no simulated checkerboard, no solid background color. Output actual transparent PNG RGBA with fully transparent empty pixels. Keep generous transparent gutters between separate buildings so each cell can be sliced. No objects may touch neighboring cell edges.
selected: Transparent-background game asset PNG with real alpha channel. Produce a 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet. SIX cozy isometric farm village buildings and TWO EMPTY transparent spare cells. Row 1: flower nursery potting shed, orchard keeper cottage, chicken coop with hen and chicks, jam making cottage workshop. Row 2: riverside tea house veranda, spacious farmhouse residence with courtyard and laundry, empty cell, empty cell. Real transparent background, isolated cutouts, no checkerboard pattern, no gray backdrop, no ground plane outside individual tiny courtyard bases. Strict equal size cells, large transparent gutters, no sprite crossing cell boundaries. Warm hand-painted terracotta roofs, creamy walls, rich green plants, same isometric view as a polished mobile farming game. Each sprite centered within its cell with 12 percent empty margin. Whole buildings visible. No text or labels. Export RGBA PNG; empty cells and spaces must have zero alpha.
